carpet.rule.renewableSpongeInMonument.de: Allows wet sponges to sustainably propagate into nearby water inside Ocean Monuments with high prismarine density.
carpet.rule.renewableSpongeInMonument.ex: Seed requirements: inside minecraft:monument bounds, >= 5 adjacent water faces, 5x5x5 prismarine-family blocks >= threshold, and 5x5x5 wet sponges < 8.
Triggered only by random ticks without cooldown; boosted x3 by an active Conduit and x1.5 / x1.2 in deep_frozen_ocean / deep_cold_ocean.
carpet.rule.renewableSpongePrismarineThr: Minimum prismarine-family blocks (prismarine, prismarine bricks, dark prismarine, sea lantern) in a 5x5x5 region for wet sponge propagation.
Applied independently to both the seed wet sponge and each candidate target water block.
carpet.rule.renewableSpongeChanceDenomin: Base hit probability denominator (1 / N) per random tick for wet sponge propagation.
Final hit chance = (1 / N) * conduit multiplier (x3 if active) * biome multiplier (x1.5 deep_frozen_ocean, x1.2 deep_cold_ocean, x1.0 otherwise).
carpet.rule.renewableSpongeConduitRadius: Query radius (in blocks) for detecting an active Conduit BlockEntity to apply the x3 propagation rate bonus.
Set to 0 to disable the Conduit rate bonus.
carpet.rule.renewableSpongeMaxSpawn.name: Renewable Sponge Max Spawn
carpet.rule.renewableSpongeMaxSpawn.desc: Maximum wet sponges generated per successful propagation tick (1 = fixed 1, 3 = weighted 1-3: 50%/30%/20%).
carpet.rule.renewableSpongeMaxSpawn.extr: Each subsequent placement re-validates the local < 8 wet sponge cap against live block state.
